Wonderful cooking class with a knowledgeable instructor
Mar 2023
We signed up for a half day cooking class - the restaurant picked us up from our hotel and brought us out to the cooking school. Our instructor Minh was very knowledgeable and took us through the garden firstly to gather ingredients prior to cooking. We made prawn spring rolls, coconut chicken, bbq pork noodle salad and banana spring rolls. Minh's instructors were very easy to follow and the food we made was delicious. Would recommend highly if you'd like to learn a few Vietnamese dishes and have some fun while you are in Ho Chi Minh City.

Wonderful experience
Jan 2023
Wonderful experience, from learning about the various herbs, mushrooms etc, picking everything fresh from the farm garden, to getting step by step guidance in cooking the most delicious, flavorful 3 course meal. The chef is not only very knowledgeable, but absolutely passionate about what he does. The numerous young trainee chefs and helpers were so friendly and helpful. To top it all off, we left with a bag full of gifts, including a recipe book, an apron, herbs etc. would definitely recommend this even to non-foodies.

Johan Fabritius
Sep 2022 • Solo
The setting of the restaurant is very peaceful. It is surrounded by rice paddies and fields with fresh produce growing all around. The food was excellent, all produce used to create the dishes were grown on the farm. There is something very special about going to pick your ingredients and have their kitchen team create something very tasty and healthy. All dietary requirements for the group I toured with were accommodated for. Just make sure you let them know of these dieatary requirements in advance of your visit! I would highly recommend the experience of visiting and I will be back. Thank you very much to Chef Tan and his team.
